content:
The messenger catches A after \(72t=24\), so \(t=\frac13\) hour.  
A receives the letter at \(48+20=68\) minutes.  
At that time, the team has traveled \(30\cdot\frac{68}{60}=34\) km, so A is \(34-24=10\) km behind.

A must close this 10 km gap within \(25\) minutes \(=\frac{5}{12}\) hour.  
Required relative speed:
\[
v-30 \ge \frac{10}{5/12}=24
\]
\[
v \ge 54
\]

\boxed{54 \text{ km/h}}
